answer: In an attestation graph, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks from trusted seeds, so influence depends on reachable endorsed paths, not raw identities. A Sybil cluster labeled juniper, pearl, or raven with few links to honest nodes has a sparse external cut and low conductance. Given a fixed seed distribution and walk budget, conductance and min-cut bounds constrain the probability mass reaching that cluster, thereby bounding its aggregate voting weight.
